DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 仕事や生活の相談についてのご来庁でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here for advice about work or daily living?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先週、仕事を辞めました。次の仕事を探したいのですが、生活の相談もあり、最初に行く所を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 離職後の求職と生活相談の最初の窓口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left my job last week. I want to find another job, but I also need advice about living expenses, so I would like to know where to go first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which desk to visit first for job hunting and living support after leaving a job. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 就職の相談と生活の相談は、それぞれ担当へつなぐことができます。今、何が一番お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can connect you with the respective staff for employment and living support. What is troubling you most at the moment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今月の家賃と、仕事を探す方法です。今日はお金を受け取れると決めて来たのではなく、状況を話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家賃と求職方法が課題で給付確定と思わないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This month's rent and how to look for work. I did not come assuming I would receive money today; I would like to explain my situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that rent and job hunting are your concerns and that you do not assume a benefit is guaranteed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用できる支援は、担当が状況を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will check your circumstances and explain what support may be available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。退職の書類はまだ全部そろっていません。そろうまで何も相談できないのか、先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 退職書類未完でも相談できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I do not yet have all my documents from leaving the company. First, I want to ask whether I can discuss anything before they are all ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can seek advice before all your leaving documents are ready. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今ある物と、ご事情を担当へお伝えください。必要な物をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell the staff what you have now and explain your circumstances. They will tell you what is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社から受け取った紙と、自分の家賃のメモがあります。足りない書類は、担当の説明を聞いてから会社へ頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現有会社書類と家賃メモを示し不足は案内後に依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the papers the company gave me and my own note about rent. I will ask the company for any missing documents after hearing the staff's explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your existing company papers and rent note, and say you will request missing documents after receiving guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 仕事を探す窓口への案内も、合わせて相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also ask for directions to the desk that helps people find work.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず生活の担当へ状況を伝え、その後に就職の相談先を聞きたいです。今日は一人で来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 生活相談を先に求めその後就職窓口の案内を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would like to explain my situation to the living support staff first, then ask where to get employment advice. I came alone today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request living support first and directions to employment advice afterward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、生活の相談担当へおつなぎします。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will connect you with the living support staff. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 待合でお困りのことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is anything troubling you in the waiting area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私の診察を待っていますが、赤ちゃんが泣き始めました。授乳できる場所を案内してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人診察待ちの赤ちゃんの授乳場所案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am waiting for my own appointment, but my baby has started crying. Could you show me somewhere I can breastfeed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for directions to a breastfeeding space while waiting for your own appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご案内できる場所を確認します。受付票はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check what space we can show you. Do you have your reception slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。診察の順番も待っているので、授乳で席を離れる間の呼出しが心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付票を示し授乳離席中の呼出しが心配と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. I am also waiting for my turn to see the doctor, so I am worried about being called while I leave my seat to breastfeed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your reception slip and explain your concern about being called while away breastfeeding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お名前と順番を受付へ伝え、戻る時のご案内も確認します。付き添いの方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell reception your name and turn, and check what you should do when you return. Is anyone accompanying you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は私一人です。赤ちゃんと荷物を一緒に持って移動するので、場所までの道も教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人同伴で子と荷物を持つため場所への道順も尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am on my own today. I will be carrying both the baby and my belongings, so I would also like directions to the space.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you are alone with the baby and bags and ask how to get there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。場所と道順、呼出しの扱いを確認しますので、少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Please wait a moment while I check the location, directions, and how your call will be handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待ちます。授乳が終わったら、元の席へ戻る前に受付へ声をかければよいかも聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 授乳後に席へ戻る前の受付連絡が必要か確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait. Could you also ask whether I should tell reception after breastfeeding, before going back to my original seat?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to check whether you should notify reception before returning to your seat after breastfeeding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻った時に声をかけていただく窓口も、合わせてご案内します。お荷物は今、そろっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will also tell you which desk to speak to when you return. Do you have all your belongings now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 布とおむつはこのかばんにあります。受付票も持って、場所と戻り方の説明を聞いてから赤ちゃんと移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 布おむつ受付票を用意し説明後に子と移動すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: The cloth and diapers are in this bag. I will take my reception slip too and move with the baby after hearing where to go and how to return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that the cloth, diapers, and reception slip are ready and that you will move with the baby after the explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、受付に確認します。赤ちゃんとこちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will check with reception. Please wait here with your baby. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: インターネットの投稿について、ご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss an online post?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知らない人の投稿に、私の家の表札と番地が写っています。心配なので、相談できる所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自宅表札番地が投稿写真に写り相談先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A stranger's post shows my home's nameplate and street number. I am worried, so please tell me where I can seek advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that a posted photo shows your home's nameplate and number, and ask where to seek advice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当へご案内します。投稿をご覧になった資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will direct you to the staff. Do you have anything showing the post you saw?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 投稿の画面を保存して、ページのアドレスも控えました。表札が読める所はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 保存した投稿画面とページのアドレスを提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I saved a screenshot of the post and wrote down the page address. This is the part where the nameplate is readable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your saved screenshot and the page address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身に届いた連絡などがあれば、それも分けてお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you have received any direct messages or other contact, please tell us about those separately too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 直接の連絡はまだありません。ただ、家族も写っているのではないかと心配しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 直接連絡はなく家族が写っているかも心配と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not received any direct contact yet. However, I am also worried that my family might be in the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have received no direct contact and are also concerned your family may appear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が状況を確認します。投稿を削除できるか、ここでお約束はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will check the situation. We cannot promise here that the post can be deleted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 削除を約束してほしいということではありません。サイトへ連絡する前に、何を記録しておくか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 削除保証と思わずサイト連絡前の記録を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am not asking for a promise to delete it. Before contacting the site, I want advice on what to keep a record of.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not expect guaranteed deletion and want advice about records before contacting the site. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ページの情報と、お困りの内容を担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show the staff the page information and explain your concerns.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族にも確認してもらいます。保存した画面とページのアドレスを担当の方へ見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族にも確認を頼み保存資料を担当へ示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask my family to check too. I will show the staff my saved screenshot and the page address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask your family to check and show the saved information to the staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらで担当をお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please wait here for the staff. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類を会社からお送りになるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You will be sending documents from your company, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。郵送料を自分で払って、後で会社へ請求します。会社名の領収書が必要なので、支払う前に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 立替郵送料の会社名領収書を支払前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I will pay the postage myself and claim it back from the company later. I need a receipt in the company's name, so I want to ask before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask before paying about a company-name receipt for postage you will pay on its behalf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 領収書の扱いを確認します。会社から、宛名の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check how receipts are handled. Has the company specified the name to put on it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この正式な会社名です。略した名前ではなく、会社から書いてもらった表記を使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 指定された正式会社名の表記を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is the company's official name. I want to use the exact wording the company wrote for me, rather than an abbreviated name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the specified official spelling of the company name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が受付内容と領収書についてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will explain the mailing details and the receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は私が立て替えます。会社名はこちらのメモに書いてあります。読みにくければ、書き直しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 立替払いと会社名メモを示し読み取れるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am paying on behalf of the company today. The company name is written on this note. Shall I rewrite it if it is hard to read?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the advance payment, show the company-name note, and check whether it is legible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: このメモで確認できます。領収書のご希望と合わせて担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can read it from this note. I will pass it to the staff along with your receipt request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。領収書は、郵便の控えと分けて受け取る物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 領収書と郵便控えを分けて受け取るのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Is the receipt something I receive separately from the mailing slip?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the receipt and the mailing slip are provided separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お渡しする書類の種類は、担当からご説明します。会社からほかに指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will explain which documents you receive. Has the company specified anything else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日付と金額も必要だと聞いています。宛名はこの会社名です。その内容で出せるか確認してから払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社が求める日付金額と宛名を伝え支払前確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I was told the date and amount are needed too. The addressee is this company name. I will pay after checking whether it can be issued with those details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the required date, amount, and company name, and confirm before paying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へ引き継ぎます。少々お待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will hand this over to the staff. Please wait a moment. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入金の確認について、お尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about checking an incoming payment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社では給料を振り込んだと言われましたが、私の記録では見つかりません。口座側で何を確認できるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社説明と本人記録が一致しない給与入金を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My company says it transferred my salary, but I cannot find it in my records. I would like to ask what can be checked on the account side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a salary deposit where the company's explanation does not match your records. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人の口座について、担当が確認をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The staff will guide you through checking your own account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社には振込先をもう一度確認してもらっています。私の口座はこちらの通帳です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社に振込先を再確認中と伝え本人通帳を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am asking the company to check the destination account again. This passbook is for my account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the company is rechecking the transfer destination and show your own passbook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 勤務先の処理については、勤務先へ確認していただく必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You will need to ask your employer about its processing of the transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 振込の日と振込先は会社から返事をもらう予定です。こちらでは、その日の前後の入金を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社へ日付と振込先を確認し銀行では前後の入金を見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The company is due to reply about the transfer date and destination account. Here, I would like to look at incoming payments around that date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you are checking the date and destination with the company and want the bank to check deposits around that date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その二つを分けて、担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain those two matters separately to the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 別の少額の入金はありますが、給料の金額とは違います。日付と振込人の名前を一緒に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 給与額と異なる少額入金があり日付と振込人名を確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is another small deposit, but it does not match the salary amount. I would like to check both the date and the sender's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that a small deposit differs from your salary and ask to check the date and sender. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認の方法と必要な物を担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will explain how to check and what you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通帳とカードを持っています。会社の返事もメモに残し、確認できた点を照らして相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通帳カードと会社返事メモを持ち照合相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have my passbook and card. I will also note down the company's reply and discuss it while comparing what has been confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have your passbook, card, and notes of the company's reply for a comparison. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当窓口へどうぞ。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please go to the appropriate desk. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 免税についての案内をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like information about tax-free shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。外国のパスポートがありますが、今は日本に住んで働いています。国籍だけで利用できるのか、買う前に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日本居住就労と外国旅券を伝え国籍のみの適用可否を問う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I have a foreign passport, but I now live and work in Japan. Before buying, I want to ask whether nationality alone makes me eligible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you live and work in Japan and hold a foreign passport, and ask whether nationality alone qualifies you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 対象となる条件は、免税の担当が確認します。ご本人の居住や入国の状況もお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The tax-free staff will check the eligibility conditions. Please also explain your residence and entry circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今の住所は日本です。入国した時の書類も必要なら、何を見せればよいか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日本の現住所を伝え入国関係の提示書類を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: My current address is in Japan. If documents from my entry are needed too, please tell me what I should show.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your current address in Japan and ask which entry-related documents to show. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その状況で担当へご相談ください。どなたのためのお買物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please discuss those circumstances with the staff. Who are you shopping for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 海外にいる家族への贈り物です。こちらの二つを考えていますが、まだ買っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 海外家族への贈答用二商品で未購入と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: These are gifts for family overseas. I am considering these two items, but I have not bought them yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the two unpurchased items are intended as gifts for family overseas. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お買い求めの商品と、必要な確認について担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will explain the products you wish to buy and what needs checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず必要な書類を確認したいです。足りない物があれば、今日は手続きせず持ち帰って用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要書類を確認し不足時は準備して出直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: First I want to check the documents required. If anything is missing, I will go home and prepare it rather than proceed today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check the required documents and prepare them before returning if any are missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認の結果によって、お支払いの扱いをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain how payment is handled according to the result of the check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。普通の値段でも予算内なので、対象になるかを聞いてから買うことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通常価格でも予算内と伝え対象確認後の購入を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. The regular price is also within my budget, so I will buy after asking whether I am eligible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the regular price is within your budget and decide to buy after checking eligibility. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へおつなぎします。ご事情を先にお知らせいただきありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will connect you with the staff. Thank you for explaining your circumstances in advance. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遊具の所で何かございましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Has something happened at the playground equipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが上まで登りましたが、怖くなって降りられないと言っています。対応できる人を呼んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遊具上で降りられない子のため担当を呼んでほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child climbed to the top but says they are scared and cannot get down. Could you call someone who can help?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask staff to help your child who cannot come down from the playground equipment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当を呼びます。どの遊具で、お子様はどこにいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will call the staff. Which equipment is it, and where is your child?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 滑り台へ上がる階段の一番上です。泣いていますが、私の声には返事をしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 階段上と泣いても応答がある状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: At the very top of the stairs leading to the slide. My child is crying but responds to my voice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the position at the top of the stairs and say your crying child still responds. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が来るまで、無理に動かそうとせず状況をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Until the staff arrive, please tell us what is happening without trying to force your child to move.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここから声をかけていますが、「怖い」と言って動けません。私もどう手伝えばよいか分からないので、担当の方をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見える所で声をかけても子が動けず担当の助けを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am talking to my child from here, but they say they are scared and cannot move. I do not know how to help either, so please get the staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your child cannot move despite you calling from within sight, and ask for staff help. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかのお子様にも、その辺りへ近づかないようご協力をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also help keep other children away from that area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一緒に来た家族に伝えます。私が登ると道をふさぎそうなので、担当の案内を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族へ区域配慮を頼み自分も登る前に案内を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will tell the family members who came with us. I might block the way if I climb up, so I want to hear the staff's instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask your family to keep the area clear and request guidance before climbing up yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ、今の状態を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will explain the current situation to the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。子どもは五歳です。怖くて足が動かないと言っていることも、そのまま伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 五歳で恐怖で足が動かないと子の言葉を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. My child is five. I will also tell them exactly what my child said: that fear is keeping their feet from moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Relay your five-year-old child's words about being too scared to move their feet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当を呼んできます。お子様の見える所でお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23238-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will call the staff. Please wait where your child can see you. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: これからのご乗車についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the train you are about to take?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜勤明けで眠くなっています。列車で寝過ごすのが心配なので、目的地を過ぎた時にどこまで行くか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜勤明けの寝過ごしを心配し行き先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sleepy after a night shift. I am worried I might sleep past my stop, so I want to know how far the train goes if I miss my destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your worry about sleeping past your stop after a night shift and ask the train's destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お乗りになる列車と目的地を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me which train you will take and your destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この列車で、目的地は三つ目の駅です。終点まで乗る予定ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 列車と三駅目の降車予定を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This train, and my destination is the third station. I do not plan to ride to the final stop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the train and say you intend to get off at the third station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 行き先表示で終点を確認できます。ただ、眠っている方を目的地で必ず起こす約束はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check the final stop on the destination display. However, we cannot promise to wake sleeping passengers at their destinations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅員さんに起こしてもらう前提にはしません。携帯で通知を設定するつもりですが、それだけで確実とは思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 起こしてもらう保証や通知だけに頼らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not assume a station employee will wake me. I plan to set an alert on my phone, but I will not assume that alone is certain either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not rely on a guaranteed wake-up or on the phone alert alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の体調も考えて、無理のない移動を選んでください。待てる場所の案内は必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please consider your condition and choose a manageable journey. Do you need directions to somewhere you can wait?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 少し座ってから乗ることも考えます。次の便まで待つなら、この待合を使ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 少し休み後便検討のため待合利用を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I might sit down for a while before boarding. If I wait for the next train, may I use this waiting room?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about using the waiting room to rest and consider a later train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらでお待ちいただけます。乗る便を変えた場合は、行き先も改めてお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You may wait here. If you change trains, please check the destination again too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待合で休んでから判断します。三つ目で降りる予定をメモし、乗る時に行き先と停車駅を見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休息後判断と行先停車駅再確認を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will rest in the waiting room before deciding. I will note that I intend to get off at the third station and recheck the destination and stops when boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to rest before choosing and recheck the destination and stops. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらの席をご利用ください。お気をつけてお帰りください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please use this seat. Have a safe journey home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 講座の申込みで分からない所がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you do not understand about applying for the course?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「親子の日本語」という名前なので、私だけ参加してもよいと思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 親子講座へ単独参加できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Since it is called Japanese for Parents and Children, I came thinking I could attend on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may attend the parent-and-child course alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この講座は、子どもと保護者が一緒に活動します。お子さんも参加予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this course, children and guardians do activities together. Will your child also attend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 子どもはその時間に学校です。私は子どもの学校の手紙を読む練習をしたいのです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子の不在と学校の手紙を読む目的を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My child will be at school then. I want to practice reading letters from my child's school.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your child's absence and your aim of reading school letters. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら、保護者向けの相談会の案内も見てみましょう。活動の内容が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: In that case, let us also look at the consultation session for guardians. The activities are different.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会話の遊びより、学校の手紙について質問できる会を探しています。こちらの相談会が合いそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会話遊びより手紙相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am looking for a session where I can ask about school letters rather than play conversation games. This consultation session seems suitable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you prefer advice on letters to conversation games. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相談会では、個人名を伏せた手紙の例を使います。実際の手紙を持参する場合は担当へ先に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: At the session, we use sample letters with personal names hidden. If you want to bring an actual letter, please check with the staff beforehand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手紙に子どもの名前があるので、持参の扱いを担当へ聞きます。親子講座には申し込みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 個人名付き手紙の持参確認と親子講座不参加を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The letter has my child's name on it, so I will ask the staff about bringing it. I will not apply for the parent-and-child course.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check about bringing a named letter and will not join the parent-and-child course. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、相談会の担当と日程をこの案内で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then let us check the session's contact and schedule in this leaflet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 担当と日程を控えました。講座名だけで判断せず、参加者と内容を確かめてから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象と内容を確認後に申し込むと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have noted the contact and schedule. Instead of deciding by the course title alone, I will check who it is for and what it covers before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to apply after checking the intended participants and content. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望が整理できましたね。それでは、担当へのご連絡をお願いします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your wishes are clearer now. Then please contact the staff. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査の案内をお持ちになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you brought your examination instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。十時と十時半の二つが書いてあり、十時半に来ればよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 案内に二時刻があり来院時刻を混同したと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Both ten and ten thirty are written here, and I thought I only needed to come at ten thirty.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you confused the arrival time because the instructions list two times. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 十時は集合の時刻、十時半は検査開始の予定です。今日はまだ間に合っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ten is the meeting time, and ten thirty is the scheduled examination start. You are still on time today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 集合してから準備があるのですね。同行者には十時半集合と伝えてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 準備時間を理解し同行者へ誤伝達したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: So there is preparation after we gather. I told my companion to meet at ten thirty.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you understand the preparation period and gave your companion the wrong time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同行者が必要な検査か担当へ確認します。まず、案内の該当欄を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check with the staff whether this examination requires a companion. First, let us look at the relevant section of the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 付き添いについてこの欄に書いてあります。相手に今連絡して、集合時刻を訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 付き添い欄を示し集合時刻を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: This section mentions a companion. I will contact them now and correct the meeting time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point out the companion section and correct the meeting time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 訂正の際は、検査開始予定も残しておくと区別しやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: When correcting it, keeping the scheduled examination start as well will make the distinction clearer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十時集合、十時半開始予定と送ります。予定が遅れたら、同行者にも伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 集合と開始予定を別々に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will send that we meet at ten and are scheduled to start at ten thirty. If the schedule is delayed, I would like to tell my companion too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the meeting time and scheduled start separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 進み具合は担当へお尋ねください。検査の準備について不明な点はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask the staff about progress. Is there anything you do not understand about preparation for the examination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 準備の欄は読みましたが、分からない語が一つあります。時刻の訂正を済ませてから、その語も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時刻訂正後に準備用語も確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I read the preparation section, but there is one word I do not understand. After correcting the time, I will ask about that word too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask about a preparation term after correcting the time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ案内を引き継ぎます。それでは、準備の説明をお待ちください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will hand the instructions over to the staff. Please wait for the preparation explanation. Take care.
